description: Mu-law and A-law compansion, the coding once used to cut noise on transmitted telephone signals; a compression section above an expansion section, each with its own law

params.text: Picks the law the compression section applies: none, A-law or mu-law
Picks the law the expansion section applies: none, A-law or mu-law
Sets the voltage range expected by the compression section, 5V or 10V
Sets the voltage range expected by the expansion section, 5V or 10V

inputs.text: A signal fed into the expansion section; with nothing patched it takes the compression output from the same side
A signal fed into the compression section, clipped to that section's voltage range

outputs.text: The compressed signal, and the source for the expansion input on the same side when nothing is patched there
